title: Multi-source blob fetch with CID verification
description: Today a blob lives only on the relay it was uploaded to (§10.3.5, §10.4.4), weakening S5 replaceability for attachments. Specify fetching a CID from any holder (other agreement relays, members' devices via self-group or channel, CO archive, public IPFS for public content only) with mandatory local CID verification; how holders are discovered without leaking membership to IOs; replication of blobs to a replacement relay. Needs design decisions.
